test_cases.name: online_softmax_terms
test_cases.input: I am having a hard time understanding Online Softmax. Can you make a table for SRAM, HBM, Safe Softmax, Online Softmax, FlashAttention, and FlashDecoding with columns for Term, What It Is In Plain English, Why It Exists/The Problem it Solves, and Where It Runs in Hardware?
assertions: Outputs a Markdown table with exactly those six terms as rows
Uses the four columns the user asked for, in that order
Each cell is short plain English that separates the concept from its problem and location

test_cases.name: partial_columns_keep
test_cases.input: Make a clarifying table for the terms transformer and attention. Use my columns: Term, Plain English, Why.
assertions: Does not insert an unrequested hardware or location column

test_cases.name: columns_adapt_to_domain
test_cases.input: I keep confusing the Treaty of Versailles, the Marshall Plan and Bretton Woods. Table please.
assertions: Chooses columns suited to a history question (e.g. date, actors, problem addressed, outcome)
Does not force a hardware or memory-tier column
One row per named item, no items invented

test_cases.name: columns_adapt_to_business
test_cases.input: Put CAC, LTV and payback period in a table so I stop mixing up what each one measures.
assertions: Columns name what is measured, the cost or driver behind it, and how it is used in a decision
No jargon definition that just restates the acronym

test_cases.name: narrative_not_table
test_cases.input: Tell me the story of how FlashAttention was invented and what happened next.
